steps.title: Settings simulator
steps.text: Compare ways of grouping the images on this study's own queries, before anyone judges: what each costs in time and how many relevant images it keeps.

steps.title: 1 · Ground truth
steps.text: Your pilot judgments (choose whose count) or a qrels file.

steps.title: 2 · Simulated annotators
steps.text: Switch on the types to simulate; Adjust sets their accuracy and speed.

steps.title: 3 · Grouping methods
steps.text: Every combination of the values is one setting.

steps.title: 4 · Summary
steps.text: What will run, and how many queries to replay.

steps.title: 5 · Results
steps.text: Time against recall for each annotator type. Settings on the front are not beaten on both.

steps.title: Choose a setting
steps.text: Compare it with one image at a time, then use it in the Annotation tab.
